assumptions: Slurry at 62 wt% coal, 40 C, 40 bar absolute, outlet 1400 C.
Ash is neglected as the exam asks.
open_questions: Which stream does 80000 Nm3/h refer to, and at which standard conditions (0 C / 101.325 kPa, or 15 C)? A coal-water slurry cannot be treated as a gas-equivalent normal volume flow without that.
Does neglecting ash allow the coal to be treated as pure carbon? If elemental analysis is available it should be used instead.
The exam provides no oxygen feed. Holding 1400 C therefore means an externally heated model with a reported duty, not autothermal gasification.
Solid-carbon support in V15 Gibbs has not been verified beyond adding the component.
blocking_questions: Define which stream 80000 Nm3/h describes and its standard conditions.
Confirm whether the coal may be represented by pure solid carbon.
